data_handling.estimate_note: about 3.24 h compute-only using 197.483 s/1000 steps; extrapolation excludes archive, analysis, variability and segment overhead
data_handling.source_family_split: all frames from this task remain in one family

decision_basis.interpretation: 0.5 ps shows marked relaxation and disordered/mobile structure indicators, but temperature is not stationary at the 1600 K setpoint. The EAM literature estimate of melting is 1267 +/- 5 K; therefore 1250 K is below this model estimate and crystallization/metastability must be explicitly checked.

liquid_structure_acceptance.1250K_recrystallization_rule: any gate failure or increasing crystalline order at 1250 K is HOLD/NO_LIQUID_AT_LOCKED_MODEL_CONDITIONS; do not change density, potential, or target to force passage
liquid_structure_acceptance.MSD: unwrap periodic trajectories; multiple-time-origin fit; over the combined 4 ps QA interval require delta-MSD >= 1.0 A^2 and the autocorrelation/block-bootstrap 95% lower confidence bound on the long-time slope > 0
liquid_structure_acceptance.RDF_rule: broad first-neighbor peak and no persistent sharp fcc/hcp-like multi-shell order within the finite-cell RDF range

phase_1_hot_liquidification.transition_when_gate_passes: as soon as two consecutive valid 2 ps windows pass after the initial 2 ps transient, automatically begin the 5 ps cooling ramp from the current global step; do not wait for the phase maximum and do not prompt the user

phase_2_controlled_cooling.temperature_schedule: linear 1600 K to 1250 K; update target every 100 steps (0.05 ps; 3.5 K per update)
phase_2_controlled_cooling.start_global_step: the global step at which the phase_1 gate passes
phase_2_controlled_cooling.transition_rule: after exactly 10000 ramp steps, automatically begin phase 3; no user prompt

phase_3_target_equilibration.transition_when_gate_passes: as soon as two consecutive valid 2 ps windows pass after the initial 2 ps post-ramp transient, automatically begin the 5 ps candidate sampling window; no user prompt
phase_3_target_equilibration.start_global_step: the global step at completion of the cooling ramp

phase_4_candidate_sampling_window.candidate_snapshot_spacing_rule: select using measured autocorrelation; at least max(0.5 ps, 5*tau_int); all snapshots remain one source family
phase_4_candidate_sampling_window.start_after_phase_3_pass: automatic immediately after the phase_3 gate passes
phase_4_candidate_sampling_window.stop_when: complete 5 ps only while all liquid QA remains passing; archive and fresh-fetch verify, then stop and report to C. No user prompt occurs at internal chunk boundaries or phase transitions.

thermal_acceptance.finite_size_note: For 64 atoms with 3N-3=189 DOF, canonical instantaneous sigma(T)/T is approximately sqrt(2/189)=10.3%; judge block means and trends, not single samples or raw instantaneous SD.
thermal_acceptance.pressure_stress: log mean and block uncertainty; require no statistically resolved drift, but do not impose an absolute pressure pass threshold in this pilot
